```

```diff
diff --git a/docs/SOP.md b/docs/SOP.md
index af3d9f1..dfd35e1 100644
--- a/docs/SOP.md
+++ b/docs/SOP.md
@@ -256,6 +256,12 @@ For significant decisions:
 3. **Document decisions** → Save to memory with tags

+

@@ -300,8 +306,10 @@ npm run start:cli -- issues create "Decision: X vs Y" \

 - [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) - Agent identity

+- [docs/PDCA_CYCLE.md](./docs/PDCA_CYCLE.md) - Continuous improvement
 - [docs/MEMORY_SYSTEM.md](./docs/MEMORY_SYSTEM.md) - Knowledge management
 - [docs/SKILL_SYSTEM.md](./docs/SKILL_SYSTEM.md) - Skills

diff --git a/src/config/Config.ts b/src/config/Config.ts
index 9775d17..595f381 100644
--- a/src/config/Config.ts
+++ b/src/config/Config.ts
@@ -38,7 +38,12 @@ function loadOrCreateAgentId(): { id: string; displayName?: string } {
   }
 
   fs.mkdirSync(configDir, { recursive: true });
-  const agentId = crypto.randomUUID();
+  const now = new Date();
+  const timestamp =
+    now.toISOString().replace(/[-:T]/g, '').substring(0, 8) +
+    '-' +
+    now.toISOString().substring(11, 16).replace(':', '');
+  const agentId = `${timestamp}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   const displayName = process.env[ENV_KEYS.AGENT_NAME];
   const data = { id: agentId, displayName: displayName || undefined };
   fs.writeFileSync(idFilePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));

```

  ],
  "findings": [...],

  ...
}
